provenance.notes: QLinearConv inherits Conv auto_pad semantics. This fixture exercises the exact SAME_UPPER spelling and derived asymmetric bottom/right padding; unit scales and zero points make the expected requantized values equal the integer convolution sums.
Signed output storage with a nonzero output zero point. The input is not a ramp, so the 2x2 kernel gives each output position its own response.
Pairs the signed input route with the independently typed uint8 output on a compact 1-D pointwise convolution.
ONNX quantized convolution requantization uses ORT's RoundHalfToEven helper; pointwise accumulators +/-1 and +/-5 with y_scale=2 produce exact +/-0.5 and +/-2.5 tie values.
Finite requantized outputs far outside uint8 must saturate; the scalar WebGPU requant pass currently converts to i32 before clamping.
A valid positive subnormal output scale can make a one-pixel convolution requantize beyond uint8; the result should saturate before any i32 conversion of an infinite f32.
Fused DP4A pointwise route with a valid positive subnormal output scale should saturate uint8 results before any i32 conversion of an infinite f32.
Valid positive subnormal input/output scales whose ratio is exactly meaningful for scalar quantization.
Uses the same quantized tensors as ORT's handwritten pointwise Conv2D test.
Adapts the handwritten 2D multi-channel/multi-output QLinearConv shape without optional bias.
Covers grouped convolution with group=3 and stride=2 using symmetric padding supported by the WebGPU manifest.
Uses ORT's grouped convolution tensors and asymmetric pads without optional bias.
Exercises the ORT-covered mixed uint8 activation / int8 weight quantization path with dilation.
Adapts QLinearConvTest.Conv2D_U8S8_Pointwise with multiple input and output channels.
Adapts QLinearConvTest.Conv2D_U8S8_Strides using stride=2 and scalar quantization.
Adapts QLinearConvTest.Conv2D_U8S8_Dilations using dilation=2.
Adapts QLinearConvTest.Conv2D_U8S8_Groups with two groups and scalar weight quantization.
Adapts QLinearConvTest.Conv2D_S8S8_Strides with signed activations, signed weights, padding, and stride.
Adapts the ORT pointwise U8/U8 path using scalar quantization and multiple output channels.
Adapts the ORT signed-activation/signed-weight pointwise path with signed output saturation.
Adapts ORT's depthwise no-bias coverage using scalar quantization and group=in_channels.
Adapts ORT's signed depthwise no-bias coverage using scalar quantization and group=in_channels.
Compact 1D convolution with symmetric padding.
Compact 1D convolution combining padding, stride, and dilation.
Compact signed 1D pointwise convolution.
Compact ORT-valid pointwise adaptation that preserves optional int32 bias semantics.
Compact ORT-valid pointwise adaptation of the 3D QLinearConv path.
Compact deterministic adaptation of ORT's 3D uint8-input/int8-weight QLinearConv coverage.
A compact three-dimensional QLinearConv uses int8 input, weights, and output.
Compact ORT-validated per-output-channel weight scales and zero-points without optional bias.
Compact mixed uint8 activation / int8 weight per-output-channel quantization case without optional bias.
Compact signed activation / signed weight projection with per-output-channel weight scales and zero-points.
Compact grouped 1x1 projection with per-output-channel weight scales and zero-points.
Compact depthwise projection with distinct per-output-channel weight scales and zero-points.
Uses a per-channel weight zero-point tensor with identical values, while keeping per-output-channel scales.
Compact 3x3 quantized convolution with nonzero zero points, 10-by-11 spatial output and 12 output channels checks exact arithmetic at tails.

The dot4 im2col route over 16 input channels. A ten-value weight cycle does not tile the nine taps of a 3x3 kernel, so every output channel carries its own filter, and the output scale resolves the accumulator instead of quantizing every position onto the zero point.
A three-dimensional quantized convolution uses a nondefault depth dilation.
Locks the common per-channel weight-scale/zero-point plus int32 bias combination on an aligned pointwise DP4A shape.
Locks four-column feature-independent accumulation with an odd output-width tail and K not divisible by four.
Locks the aligned-padding DP4A fallback for a realistic odd channel count on devices without shader-f16. Padding uses raw zero points and must remain exact.

Odd K=81 with a nonzero input zero point and a per-channel weight zero point checks exact convolution arithmetic; an 18x18 input with no padding reduces to a 16x16 output over 9 input and 32 output channels.
Odd K=27 and int32 bias check exact quantized convolution through the final three reduction elements.
Three-dimensional quantized convolution checks zero-point-filled spatial padding and per-output-channel quantization.
Compact grouped 3x3 QLinearConv with four output channels per group and an odd output width checks exact quantized results at a spatial tail.

ONNX auto_pad SAME_LOWER places the odd padding element at the start of the axis. The nonzero leading pad verifies that execution uses the derived padding rather than unrelated explicit pad attributes.
A one-dimensional quantized convolution carrying a bias, which is the ordinary audio form. The bias is non-zero so the case proves it is applied, not merely that a route exists.
A three-dimensional quantized convolution includes a nonzero bias.
One-dimensional convolution uses weights quantized independently per output channel.

Independent integer stencil sum gives ±(2^24+1) in the full contraction. Explicit nearest-even byte outputs preserve the low-bit distinction; partial/padded pixels are included. No bias or int32 overflow.
